purpose: Specify deterministic implementation details that were not numerically explicit in the parent protocol. No economic rule, event selection, horizon, cost, or promotion threshold changes.

price_parse_rule.source_bytes: Use the immutable raw BNBBTC ZIPs from canonical market-source artifact 10460668190. Every ZIP SHA256 must match the committed market-source manifest before parsing any open value.
price_parse_rule.required_entry_exit_match: Every frozen selected entry and exit timestamp must map to exactly one 15-minute row. Any missing or duplicate price row fails closed before economic classification.

statistics.mean: arithmetic mean across resolved selected trades
statistics.median: standard sample median; for even N average the two central observations
statistics.profit_factor: sum(max(net_bps,0)) / abs(sum(min(net_bps,0))); +Infinity only if denominator is zero and positive numerator exists
statistics.win_rate: fraction of net_bps strictly greater than zero
statistics.positive_contribution_concentration: max positive BASE net_bps divided by sum positive BASE net_bps; 1.0 if exactly one positive trade; null if no positive trades

bootstrap.sampling: iid event-level draws with replacement from BASE net_bps
bootstrap.ci_method: sorted bootstrap means with linear-interpolated empirical quantiles at p=0.025 and p=0.975 using index h=(B-1)*p, lower=floor(h), upper=ceil(h), interpolation weight=h-floor(h)
